title: Bunny Shell desktop session
description: The graphical session. Needs a display and enough memory to hold a compositor; degrades to the safe session, which is the same shell with the extension inert.

implementations.title: Bunny Shell on GNOME
implementations.description: The full session with the Bunny extension, launcher, workspaces and search surfaces.

implementations.title: Bunny Safe Shell
implementations.description: The same session with the Bunny target stopped and the extension a no-op. Not a reduced product: the identical shell with one component inert.
